description: Azure Firewall logs. Uses the resource-specific tables (AZFW*). The legacy AzureDiagnostics variant is at the bottom.

queries.name: Denied network traffic (top flows)
queries.description: Most frequently denied source / destination / port combinations.
kql: | summarize Hits = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by SourceIp, DestinationIp, DestinationPort, Protocol

queries.name: Network rule traffic for an IP
queries.description: Everything the firewall saw to or from one IP, with the rule that matched.
kql: | project TimeGenerated, Action, Protocol, SourceIp, SourcePort, DestinationIp, DestinationPort, Policy, RuleCollectionGroup, RuleCollection, Rule

queries.name: Network rule traffic to a destination port
queries.description: Who is talking to a given port (RDP 3389, SSH 22, SMB 445 ...).
kql: | summarize Hits = count(), Allowed = countif(Action == 'Allow'), Denied = countif(Action == 'Deny'), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)

queries.name: Denied application rule requests (top FQDNs)
queries.description: FQDNs the firewall is blocking most, and how many sources hit them.
kql: | summarize Hits = count(), Sources = dcount(SourceIp), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Fqdn

queries.name: Application rule hits for an FQDN
queries.description: Requests matching a (partial) FQDN, with action and rule.

queries.name: Application rule traffic from a source IP
queries.description: What a single client tried to reach and whether it was allowed.
kql: | summarize Hits = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Action, Fqdn

queries.name: DNS proxy lookups for a name
queries.description: Who queried a domain through the firewall DNS proxy.

queries.name: DNS proxy top query names for a client
queries.description: Most queried names from one source IP.
kql: | summarize Queries = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by QueryName

queries.name: Threat intelligence hits
queries.description: Traffic matched against Microsoft threat intelligence.

queries.name: Denied traffic (legacy AzureDiagnostics mode)
queries.description: For firewalls still logging to the AzureDiagnostics table instead of the resource-specific tables.
kql: | parse kind=relaxed msg_s with Protocol ' request from ' SourceIp ':' SourcePort:int ' to ' Destination ':' DestPort:int '. Action: ' Action '.' *
| project TimeGenerated, Category, Protocol, SourceIp, SourcePort, Destination, DestPort, Action, msg_s
